title: REVEAL: Reverse Engineering Agentic Latents from Frontier-Model Traces
abstract: arXiv:2610.16288v2 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Frontier LLM agents perform complex interactive tasks, but their inference costs motivate transferring their experience to smaller open-source agents. Distillation and latent communication typically require target-model training or access to source-model internals. We study how textual frontier-model trajectories can provide reusable local controls for a frozen agent. Inspired by protocol reverse engineering, we introduce $\textit{Agentic Latents}$, comprising anchored states and dynamic profiles of feedback--response cycles elicited by replay in the target model. translated_title: REVEAL：从前沿模型轨迹中逆向工程智能体潜变量
translated_abstract: 前沿大语言模型智能体能够执行复杂的交互任务，但其高昂的推理成本促使人们将它们的经验迁移到更小的开源智能体中。蒸馏和潜变量通信方法通常需要对目标模型进行训练，或需要访问源模型的内部结构。我们研究了文本形式的前沿模型轨迹如何能为冻结的智能体提供可复用的局部控制。受协议逆向工程的启发，我们提出了“智能体潜变量”，它由锚定状态以及通过在目标模型中重放而引出的反馈-响应循环的动态特征组成。我们的免训练框架REVEAL（REVerse Engineering Agentic Latents，逆向工程智能体潜变量）利用这些特征和轨迹结果，从同一任务和同一源模型的成功与失败回放中匹配并筛选局部事件。这些局部事件的响应转移对比产生了针对目标模型的引导方向，并应用于每次响应之前。
tldr: 提出免训练框架REVEAL，通过逆向工程从前沿模型轨迹中提取“智能体潜变量”，为冻结的小型开源智能体提供可复用的局部引导控制，无需训练目标模型或访问源模型内部。
en_tdlr: REVEAL is a training-free framework that reverse-engineers "Agentic Latents" from frontier-model traces to provide reusable local steering controls for frozen smaller open-source agents, without requiring target-model training or access to source-model internals.
